programme.title: Alana : Déesse de Justice
programme.desc: Séparée de ses parents à la naissance suite à une éruption volcanique, puis ayant grandi dans une société très injuste, Alana tente de comprendre le mystère de ses crises de colère. Quand elle apprend qu'elle est la réincarnation de Sri Asih, la déesse de justice, elle va mettre ses super-pouvoirs au service du bien contre la corruption et le crime organisé.

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Lorsque James, un chauffeur Uber, et sa passagère Jessica, passent prendre le charismatique mais néanmoins manipulateur Bruno, leur trajet dans Los Angeles se transforme en une véritable lutte psychologique pour survivre.

programme.title: 7 Minutes
programme.desc: Après avoir contracté une dette auprès d'un dangereux baron de la drogue, trois jeunes hommes désespérés décident de commettre un braquage pour réunir l'argent qui leur manque.

programme.title: Ip Man : L'Éveil du maître
programme.desc: Lors d'une visite à Hong Kong, le jeune Maître Ip intervient dans une tentative d'enlèvement, déclenchant sans le vouloir une guerre au sein d'un impitoyable réseau de trafic d'êtres humains. En représailles, le gang kidnappe l'un des amis proches d'Ip Man, qui n'a d'autre choix que de se mesurer au champion de boxe notoirement brutal du groupe.

programme.title: Captivity
programme.desc: Lors d'une mission solitaire sur Mars, le cosmonaute Chapaev est contraint d'atterrir en urgence après plusieurs incidents techniques. Piégé sur la planète rouge, il fait une découverte inexplicable qui bouleverse son existence. Devenu une légende sur Terre, parviendra-t-il à survivre ?

programme.title: Le distributeur d'aurores boréales
programme.desc: Lola collectionne les horloges cassées depuis qu'elle a perdu sa mère. Une nuit, elle découvre que l'une d'elle est hantée... Peut-on tomber amoureux d'un fantôme? Que se passerait-il s'il revenait dans la réalité ?

programme.title: Regards libres
programme.desc: Des enfants observent, commentent et critiquent un tableau.

programme.title: Tomatl, chronique de la fin d'un monde
programme.desc: La tomate fut découverte par les européens en même temps que le Nouveau Monde. Les Aztèques léguèrent cette plante, qui couvre aujourd'hui le tiers des surfaces de la planète...

programme.title: Kroak
programme.desc: Kroak part pêcher tôt le matin. De son baluchon, il sort tout une panoplie d'outils et attend le poisson qui ne vient pas. Lorsque ça mord enfin, c'est un refrigérateur qui sort de l'eau, puis une table dressée et enfin un drôle de poisson.

programme.title: Personne ne s'aimera jamais comme on s'aime
programme.desc: Pauline et Noham s'aiment à la folie. Quand la mère de Pauline lui annonce qu'elles déménagent à Paris, Pauline, incapable de se séparer de Noham, décide de rester vivre dans sa ville natale. Seulement voilà, Pauline n'a que dix ans…

programme.title: Le bûcheron des mots
programme.desc: Dans un pays où les habitants se nourrissent, au sens propre, de lettres et de mots cueillis dans les arbres, la lecture est vitale s'ils ne veulent pas mourir... d'ennui. Mais certains livres sont interdits à cause de leur contenu émotionnel et des transformations physiques qu'ils provoquent. Nadal, un bûcheron des mots, fait une rencontre qui change définitivement sa vie...

programme.title: Circuit marine
programme.desc: Un bateau en haute mer, les marins pêchent, mangent, boivent...et chantent. Le chat regarde le perroquet, le perroquet regarde le joli poisson dans son bocal, le chat regarde le poisson... Qui mangera qui ?

programme.title: La grande migration
programme.desc: Les aventures humoristiques d'un oiseau migrateur qui perd ses congénères dans les nuages...

programme.title: Una furtiva lagrima
programme.desc: Ultime voyage d'un poisson qui chante son propre requiem, depuis la vente à la poissonnerie jusque dans la poêle à frire.

programme.title: Fatigués d'être beaux
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys partent à la recherche d'une balle qu'ils ont tirée dans le désert.

programme.title: Pépé le morse
programme.desc: Sur la plage sombre et venteuse, Mémé prie, Maman hurle, les frangines s'en foutent, Lucas est seul. Pépé était bizarre comme type, maintenant il est mort.

programme.title: Les chiens isolés
programme.desc: Sur une plateforme pétrolière, une histoire d'amitié entre deux ouvriers se voit compromise par la démence paranoïaque de l'un deux.

programme.title: Shudo
programme.desc: Deux samurais s'affrontent sur un champ de bataille ravagé par la guerre. Absorbés par leur orgueil, ils se lancent dans un duel alimenté par leur ressentiment.

programme.title: Le portefeuille
programme.desc: Un jour, un homme trouve un portefeuille par terre. Ou bien, ne l'a-t-il pas vu ? Il décide de le rendre à son propriétaire et aussi de le garder pour lui.

programme.title: L'évasion
programme.desc: Un homme est en prison. Son compagnon de cellule est torturé jusqu'à la mort. Quand ses geôliers viennent le chercher à son tour, il parvient à s'enfuir dans l'enceinte du bâtiment. Geste désespéré car il s'agit d'un vrai labyrinthe. Il échappe pourtant à ses poursuivants jusqu'au toit de l'immeuble. Du haut des miradors, un militaire le tient en joue. Là il exprime devant eux toute la mesure de sa liberté.

programme.title: Nimbus Machina
programme.desc: Le désert, le vent, un rail. Une étrange machine passe et crache de gigantesques nuages de vapeur et de suie.

programme.title: Les voiles du partage
programme.desc: Etienne Bernard part en exil dans les terres du Nord pour y chercher l'aventure. A peine arrivé, il est plongé directement dans l'ambiance : la ville est aux mains d'une mafia locale qui fait du trafic de chars à voile...

programme.title: Betty's blues
programme.desc: Un jeune guitariste tente sa chance dans un vieux bar de blues de Louisiane. Il évoque la légende de Blind Boogie Jones, dans la Nouvelle Orléans des années 1920, une histoire d'amour et de vengeance...

programme.title: Ephémères
programme.desc: Sur le mur d'une vieille maison, un éphémère cherche sa place parmi les photos de famille.

programme.title: Petit bonhomme
programme.desc: Henri a neuf ans pas tout à fait et demi. Le temps d'un après-midi à la piscine, il décide de suivre les conseils de son père pour séduire la petite Rachel dont il est fou amoureux.

programme.title: Billy the Killy
programme.desc: Un documentaire sur la façon dont Martin Gretschmann compose un chef-d'œuvre de musique binaire. Une boite à rythme lance l'installation tandis qu'une enclume la stoppe net. Entre les deux, une succession d'images dont une poupée qui adresse un clin d'œil à Kill Bill…

programme.title: Train de vie
programme.desc: Dans une gare perdue en pleine cambrousse, le retard d'un train va amener trois personnages à sortir de leur isolement quotidien.

programme.title: T'étais où quand Michaël Jackson est mort ?
programme.desc: Paris, quelques jours après la mort du roi de la pop, quelques jours avant noël, une rencontre les bouscule, Elle et Lui, à l'arrière d'un taxi. Ils roulent au milieu des lumières de la ville, le temps d'un désir.

programme.title: La révolution des crabes
programme.desc: Les crabes de l'estuaire de la Gironde ont un sérieux handicap : ils ne peuvent pas changer de direction et sont condamnés à marcher toute leur vie suivant la même ligne droite. Comment vivent-ils ce tragique destin ?

programme.title: Des millions de larmes
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une rencontre dans un café-restaurant désert le long d'une route. Un homme d'une soixantaine d'années qui attend là. Une jeune femme fait son entrée, un sac sur le dos, sa vie dedans et la mine passablement fatiguée. Il lui propose de l'avancer. Elle accepte.

programme.title: Bande démo
programme.desc: Samir est un comédien Belge, débrouillard, beau parleur, mais habitué aux complications à répétition. Lorsqu'il parvient à décrocher ce rendez-vous avec un agent important, les choses se compliquent lorsque ce dernier lui demande d'apporter sa bande démo…

programme.title: Bang Bang !
programme.desc: Bang ! Bang ! C'est l'ouverture de la chasse. Et aussi l'anniversaire d'Éda : vingt-cinq ans. Pour fêter ça, son père lui offre un appartement qui vient d'être saisi. Happy Birthday ! Éda fuit. Elle roule vite, trop vite. Quand un chien rose surgit dans ses phares, c'est l'accident. Effrayée par l'étrange animal, elle s'engouffre dans la forêt où son père mène la chasse…

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Robin se fait larguer par sa copine, Annie, parce qu'il n'arrive pas à lui exprimer ses sentiments. Aidé de son chien, il va tout faire pour la récupérer.

programme.title: Mortal break-up inferno
programme.desc: La traque infernale d'un jeune homme par sa copine qui n'a pas digéré leur rupture.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: La semaine des 4 jeudis
programme.desc: Marc a rencontré une fille qui lui a tapé dans l'oeil. Leur histoire va être d'autant plus compliquée que la semaine des quatre jeudis commence aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Fugazi
programme.desc: 2039 : depuis plus de 3 ans, Adèle travaille pour Orbit Defence, une station spatiale chargée du pilotage de drones sur la planète Terre. Aujourd'hui, tenant entre ses mains des joysticks, il ne lui reste plus qu'une mission de routine à accomplir avant de rejoindre enfin sa famille.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Un prince et son serviteur apprennent qu'une magnifique princesse est plongée dans un sommeil éternel suite à une malédiction. Ils se lancent dans un dangereux périple et doivent affronter une reine maléfique et une armée de morts-vivants pour la délivrer.

programme.title: Let Us Prey
programme.desc: C'est la première nuit d'Ed et Sarah dans leur nouvelle maison : une ferme isolée à la frontière de l'Ecosse. Alors qu'ils pensaient échapper au stress de leur vie londonienne le sommeil de Sarah est troublé par des bruits suspects. Leur nouvelle vie se transforme en cauchemar lorsque le couple part faire des investigations dans les bois à la nuit tombée. Ils réalisent alors qu'ils ne sont pas ici chez eux et encore moins les bienvenus.

programme.title: TAI CHI HERO
programme.desc: À propos des premières années de Yang Luchan, maître de Tai-chi. L'homme qui a fondé le Tai-chi au XIXe siècle et ce qui est aujourd'hui devenu le style de Tai-chi le plus populaire au monde. Le deuxième volet de la trilogie "Tai Chi" poursuit le parcours de Yang Luchan, un enfant prodige qui a aidé à sauver un village des soldats.

programme.title: Hwayi: A Monster Boy
programme.desc: Hwayi est un garçon qui vit dans un village agricole. Il a été élevé par cinq pères, tous des criminels notoires. Un jour, le groupe reçoit l'ordre d'assassiner un homme nommé Lim et sa femme.

programme.title: Cross Of Fire
programme.desc: L'histoire de l'ascension et de la chute du leader du Ku Klux Klan des années 1920, D.C. Stephenson.

programme.title: My Soul To Take
programme.desc: Dans la petite ville de Riverton, la légende clame qu'un serial killer a juré de revenir assassiner les sept enfants nés la nuit où il est mort. Aujourd'hui, seize ans plus tard, de nouvelles personnes disparaissent. Le psychopathe s'est-il réincarné dans l'un des sept ados, ou a-t-il survécu à cette nuit où il fut laissé pour mort ?

programme.title: Pets To The Rescue
programme.desc: Lorsque un frère et une sœur sont enlevés après avoir trouvé un camion d'or volé, ce sont leurs animaux de compagnie qui doivent prendre les choses en main pour les sauver !

programme.title: Gandahar
programme.desc: Gandahar, paisible oasis au cour d'une galaxie agitée, est menacée par une force terrible et mystérieuse.

programme.title: Chaudes nuits d'été
programme.desc: Daniel, un adolescent maladroit, se retrouve durant un été à la tête d'un trafic de drogue, tout en tombant amoureux de l'énigmatique sœur de son associé.

programme.title: Joe Baby
programme.desc: Chargée de récupérer 10 millions de dollars disparus dans une sombre affaire immobilière, Joe Baby, détective privée, se retrouve entraînée dans une affaire où tout semble ramener à la mort mystérieuse de son père, Walter Baby.

programme.title: Les messagers
programme.desc: Un film d'horreur avec Kristen Stewart dans lequel une famille en quête d'un nouveau départ se retrouve à la merci d'une force maléfique dans sa nouvelle maison.

programme.title: Mi-Temps Au Mitard
programme.desc: La star légendaire du Football Américain Paul Crewe se retrouve en prison et y retrouve l'ancien entraîneur Nate Scarboro. La direction de la prison organise chaque année un tournoi entre les surveillants et les prisonniers.

programme.title: Deux chefs et un gâteau de mariage
programme.desc: Un critique gastronomique de renom se heurte à un chef qui refuse les critiques au mariage de sa sœur.

programme.title: Méfiez-vous de la baby-sitter
programme.desc: Stella embauche Blake comme nounou, ignorant que c'est sa fille biologique venue pour détruire sa famille.

programme.title: Le meilleur cuisinier
programme.desc: Melissa McCarthy partage l'affiche avec une troupe de génies de la comédie et un mocumentaire délicieusement espiègle sur le monde passionné et cruel de la compétition culinaire.

programme.title: Passion Trouble
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une femme rencontre un homme qu'elle croit être son âme sœur, d'étranges événements se produisent dans sa vie, lui faisant croire qu'elle devient folle.

programme.title: Le meurtrier de minuit
programme.desc: Des inconnus composent un jury dans l'affaire de tueur en série la plus notoire de San Francisco. À présent, quelqu'un, ou quelque chose, les tue les unes après les autres.

programme.title: Les mystérieuses cartes de Noël
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une journaliste d'enquête découvre de mystérieuses cartes vierges après l'enterrement de sa mère, elle cherche à découvrir les secrets du passé de sa mère.

programme.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
programme.desc: M. et Mme Renard vivent heureux jusqu'à ce qu'ils préparent un vol de poules.

programme.title: Le Smoking
programme.desc: Jimmy Tong, simple chauffeur de taxi devenu chauffeur personnel, enfile un smoking d'une valeur de 2 milliards de dollars appartenant à un espion et devient sans le vouloir un fringant agent secret.

programme.title: Fat Man And Little Boy
programme.desc: Au Nouveau Mexique, le très secret Manhattan Project vise à construire la première bombe atomique, sous la direction de Robert Oppenheimer.

programme.title: Suicide Tourist
programme.desc: Max, détective pour une assurance, apprend qu'il est condamné par une tumeur. Enquêtant sur un homme disparu, il arrive à l'hôtel Aurora, lieu isolé où l'on accompagne les suicides. Hanté par sa propre fin, il découvre un univers troublant.

programme.title: She's so lovely
programme.desc: Après avoir été libéré d'une institution psychiatrique, un homme tente de se racheter aux yeux de son ex-femme des événements qui ont conduit à son incarcération.

programme.title: The Escort
programme.desc: Prêt à tout pour trouver un sujet d'article intéressant, un journaliste suit une prostituée diplômée de Stanford et s'introduit dans le monde des escorts girls de luxe.

programme.title: Big Divorce
programme.desc: Fraîchement fiancé à Dylan, Michael se met en tête de retrouver son amour de jeunesse, Alex. La flamme renaît entre eux, et Michael envisage alors de rompre ses fiançailles.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: Dans cette adaptation du classique de 83, Julie (Jessica Rothe) incarne parfaitement la petite fille parfaite qui voit son univers bouleversé lorsqu'elle tombe amoureuse de Randy (Josh Whitehouse), un punk rocker d'Hollywood !

programme.title: Amoureux pour le Show
programme.desc: Suit l'histoire de Tara Thompson, dont la carrière de présentatrice commence à stagner. Elle accepte de participer à une émission télévisée pour épouser son partenaire idéal , Joe, un homme qu'elle n'a jamais rencontré. Mais en secret, elle tente de le retrouver pour clarifier que le mariage n'est que pour...

programme.title: À Ceux qui Nous Ont Offensés
programme.desc: Vivants en parias à la périphérie du Gloucestershire, trois générations de Cutler, la célèbre famille de criminels professionnels, passent leur temps à planifier leur prochain casse et à se moquer de la police. Mais de plus en plus, Chad, l'aîné, qui est sous la coupe de Colby, le patriarche de la famille et maître des opérations, se retrouve tiraillé entre son désir de mener une vie tranquille avec sa femme et son fils, loin du crime, et le respect mêlé de crainte qu'il éprouve pour son père. Lorsque Colby élabore un plan visant une collection d'art privée, une vie entière de mauvaises décisions, de violence insensée et de criminalité commence à s'effondrer, soulignant le fait que Chad, digne fils et héritier de son père, doit faire un choix. Chad trouvera-t-il le courage de s'affirmer et de prendre son envol, ou détruira-t-il la famille ? Après tout, il n'en a qu'une.

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: Céleste, une jeune fille de 15 ans, reçoit des paquets de lingerie accompagnés de mots pervers. Sa mère, que cette situation inquiète, se rend à la brigade des mœurs. Les soupçons se portent rapidement sur le voisin, Pascal Cardinaels, divorcé et père de deux enfants, Roxanne, 15 ans, et Baptiste, 7 ans. Céleste est la baby-sitter de Baptiste, et Pascal Cardinaels la paie très généreusement pour cette activité…

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: Céleste, une jeune fille de 15 ans, reçoit des paquets de lingerie accompagnés de mots pervers. Sa mère, que cette situation inquiète, se rend à la brigade des mœurs. Les soupçons se portent rapidement sur le voisin, Pascal Cardinaels, divorcé et père de deux enfants, Roxanne, 15 ans, et Baptiste, 7 ans. Céleste est la baby-sitter de Baptiste, et Pascal Cardinaels la paie très généreusement pour cette activité…

programme.title: Piégés
programme.desc: Dans un flashback, Ernesto, un jeune escroc, raconte comment il s'est retrouvé au bord d'un gros coup : une enfance à l'orphelinat, des cambriolages à la volée jusqu'à ce que son complice se fasse arrêter, puis l'apprentissage auprès de Lefty, un escroc vieillissant. Après quelques années de succès, ils sont rejoints par Federico, le meilleur, un véritable artiste. Tout se passe bien jusqu'à ce que Pilar, une femme du passé de Federico, refasse surface avec une proposition : arnaquer une véritable poule aux œufs d'or, une escroquerie qui pourrait les mettre à l'abri du besoin. Mais une trahison pourrait bien se préparer. Le flashback terminé, Ernesto saura-t-il tirer son épingle du jeu dans le présent ?

programme.title: Oxygen
programme.desc: Deux gars kidnappent la femme d'un homme riche et l'enterrent dans une boîte avec 24 heures d'oxygène.

programme.title: Criminals: Le Dernier Casse
programme.desc: Différentes actions menées dans la ville de Londres, contre l'environnement violent du trafic d'armes.

programme.title: Noël entre filles
programme.desc: Sarah, Cat et Riley se retrouvent dans leur maison d'enfance pour recréer la magie de Noël. À un tournant de leur vie, les trois amies découvrent que l'esprit des fêtes peut tout changer.

programme.title: Le nombre magique de Noël
programme.desc: À l'approche de Noël, un conseiller financier commence à voir un chiffre récurrent : 624. On lui dit que c'est un ange de Noël qui a exaucé son souhait. Elle dit que c'est une coïncidence statistique. Mais lorsqu'elle en découvre le sens, elle trouve l'amour.

programme.title: L'amour n'est jamais bien loin
programme.desc: Après une rupture médiatisée, Charley, fondatrice d'une application de rencontres, fait équipe avec Liam, expert marketing audacieux, pour sauver son entreprise. Ensemble, ils découvrent que l'amour était peut-être juste là.

programme.title: Un amour de photographe
programme.desc: Laura, assistante de galerie passionnée de photo, doit convaincre Shane, un artiste retiré du monde depuis dix ans, d'exposer ses clichés. En l'aidant à retrouver l'inspiration, elle pourrait aussi trouver sa propre voie.

programme.title: Supergrave
programme.desc: Evan et Seth sont deux amis pas très futés qui ne peuvent pas se passer l'un de l'autre. Pourtant, il va bien falloir qu'ils apprennent, parce que cette année, ils sont inscrits dans deux universités différentes ! Evan est craquant, plutôt intelligent et constamment terrifié par la vie - et les filles en particulier.

programme.title: Chair De Poule
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon déménage avec sa mère et sa soeur dans la petite ville de Greendale, dans le Maryland. Sur place, il rencontre l'écrivain RL Stine, auteur à succès de romans d'épouvante pour adolescents…

programme.title: Chair de Poule 2
programme.desc: Ne soyez pas trop curieux ! Pour préparer la brocante de l'école, deux meilleurs amis : Sonny et Sam, sont en quête de trésors qu'auraient précipitamment abandonnés les gens dans leurs ordures. Mais après avoir passé au crible la vielle maison de M. Stine, ils ouvrent un livre jusqu'à lors scellé qui libère un cauchemar surnaturel : Slappy ! Une course contre la montre s'engage alors, avec l'aide de Sarah la sœur de Sonny, ils vont tout mettre en œuvre pour tenter de ramener le Pantin maléfique et tous les monstres qu'il a ressuscité à l'intérieur du livre, avant qu'il ne répande un chaos total...

programme.title: Une Équipe Hors Du Commun
programme.desc: La seconde guerre mondiale déclarée, les joueurs professionels de Base-Ball partent au front. Afin de sauver les clubs et le sport, des propriétaires de clubs s'associent pour créer une ligue de base-ball féminine.

programme.title: Pixie
programme.desc: Pixie entreprend de venger la mort de sa mère et tente un cambriolage qui lui donnera les moyens de quitter sa vie de petite ville. Lorsque le plan tourne terriblement mal, elle est obligée de faire équipe avec une paire de truands.

programme.title: The Walking Deceased
programme.desc: Un mois après l'apocalypse zombie, un groupe de survivants cherche un endroit où se réfugier.

programme.title: George and the Dragon
programme.desc: Le jour où Luna, la fille du roi, disparaît, Georges, un valeureux chevalier, accompagné de son fidèle guerrier Garth, partent à la recherche de la princesse. En affrontant de multiples dangers, leur route va croiser celle dun gigantesque dragon et de dangereux mercenaires.

programme.title: Espion et Demi
programme.desc: Lorsque le prototype d'un avion espion des plus sophistiqués est dérobé au gouvernement américain, l'agent Alex Scott, est appelé en urgence. Il doit faire équipe avec un civil, Kelly Robinson, champion du monde de boxe très suffisant et sûr de lui mais sans expérience de l'espionnage.

programme.title: Kids in America
programme.desc: Quand le principal d'un lycée abuse de son pouvoir pour restreindre la liberté d'expression à l'intérieur de l'établissement, un groupe de sept jeunes, encouragés par un professeur passionné, s'allient pour protester contre l'hypocrisie de leur administration.

programme.title: La caravane vers l'Ouest
programme.desc: Deux caravanes de chariots convergent vers ce qui est aujourd'hui Kansas City et s'unissent pour se diriger vers l'Oregon.

programme.title: Le banni
programme.desc: Les légendes de l'Ouest Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday et Billy the Kid s'affrontent pour la loi et les attentions de la vivace mégère Rio McDonald.

programme.title: La Chevauchée des bannis
programme.desc: Blaise Starrett est un éleveur en conflit avec les propriétaires terriens lorsque des hors-la-loi attaquent la petite ville.

programme.title: Sitting Bull
programme.desc: Un officier de cavalerie sympathisant des Sioux organise une rencontre entre Sitting Bull et le président Grant, mais un agent indien met à l'épreuve la patience des Sioux.

programme.title: Les amours de Salomé

programme.title: Liz Earle On Her Perimenopause And Midlife Reinvention

programme.title: Ruby Wax On Why Trump Scares Her!
programme.desc: Have you noticed that your memory and rational thinking disappear when you're anxious? Ruby Wax wants you to retrain your focus and attention in a digital world that's always trying to steal it. In this chat with Fearne – live from the Happy Place Festival – Ruby explains the difference between mental health and mental illness, and why she calls meditation 'mind gym'.

programme.title: Dr Julie on Triggers And Behaviour Patterns
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Julie Smith discusses why criticism hurts so deeply, explaining how your brain needs evidence rather than mantras to build self-worth and change your critical inner voice. She explores why feedback from others can trigger old wounds and how patterns developed in childhood keep replaying in adulthood.

programme.title: Ruth Langsford On Coping With Grief & Loss
programme.desc: Broadcaster Ruth Langsford opens up about navigating divorce, grief, and the emotional reality of caring for parents with dementia. From therapy breakthroughs to the power of female friendships, Ruth shares the tools that have helped her find strength in life's most difficult moments. Fearne and Ruth compare their experiences of mum guilt, and why it's so important for young boys in particular to see the women in their life working. Ruth also reveals the sliding doors moment that led her to her TV presenting career. Content warning: this episode contains conversations about grief after suicide.

programme.title: Zayn Malik's Secret to Slow Living
programme.desc: Musician Zayn talks through the quiet lifestyle he loves in Pennsylvania: painting, being outdoors, spending time with his daughter, and staying off his phone. He explains how fatherhood has changed him, whether he's the parent he thought he would be, and what impact the new depths of emotion he feels has had on his music.

programme.title: Daisy May & Charlie Cooper Discuss Their Careers And Growing Up Working Class
programme.desc: Actors Daisy May and Charlie Cooper, siblings behind the hit show This Country, join Fearne Cotton to discuss how growing up working class shaped their work ethic, creativity, and resilience. programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: JOE Pub Quiz with TommyInnit and Max Fosh
programme.desc: TommyInnit and Max Fosh go head-to-head in the Joe Pub Quiz with a YouTube twist, battling it out across rounds testing their knowledge of the platform, iconic YouTube moments and some of the biggest names in internet history. From guessing who said which iconic line, to throwback YouTube apologies from Logan Paul, classic Sidemen diss tracks and a final rapid-fire round where they have to identify famous YouTubers from photos. Along the way, Tommy and Max also get into some of the biggest debates in YouTube history, including whether we need to bring proper YouTube apologies back, the golden era of diss tracks and what KSI leaving the Sidemen means for them.

programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: On The Ground At Tommy Robinson's Rally
programme.desc: Around 60,000 people gathered at Parliament Square on 16 May for Tommy Robinson's Unite The Kingdom rally, ostensibly to defend freedom, protect children, and take the country back. It was the smaller of two protests in central London, with at least a quarter of a million attending a pro-Palestine rally commemorating the 78th anniversary of the Nakba and uniting against the far-right. On the rally's main stage, a man covered in bacon played the cello.

programme.title: Kneecap Interview
programme.desc: Kneecap joined PoliticsJOE following the dismissal of their terror case against member Mo Chara in the British courts. The band discussed the legal proceedings, which centred on allegations that Chara displayed a Hezbollah flag during a London concert in November 2024. UK prosecutors had argued this could constitute an offence under the Terrorism Act, but the case was thrown out due to procedural failures.

programme.title: Glen Powell Takes The Irish Test
programme.desc: Glen Powell and Edgar Wright are put to the test to see if they can earn themselves an honourary Irish passport. To do so, they must pass a series of tests to prove their Irishness. programme.title: Sin City Weddings

Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: World's Rarest
programme.desc: The world is facing an urgent biodiversity crisis. Untold numbers of animals are at risk of being lost forever, with many species racing towards extinction. In this show, we try to highlight some of these incredible creatures, from the plucky pangolins to the critically endangered rhinoceroses, who live in constant fear of the poacher's bullet. Films provide a record of Earth's wonderful wildlife, but this is hopefully not an archive of what's lost, but evidence of what we should be preserving.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. And they're not just stealthy, they're also some of the most enigmatic and beautiful creatures on the planet.

programme.title: Rottnest Island: Kingdom Of The Quokka
programme.desc: Islands worldwide are grand experiments in nature, with their isolation creating unique conditions for animals to diverge from the norm. On the far west of the Australian continent lies Rottnest Island where one of the worlds ‘happiest', yet most vulnerable marsupials the Quokka thrives. How do they survive here in such inhospitable conditions and nowhere else? In a world first, the entire life cycle of the Quokka will be filmed using special natural history filming techniques to expose the secrets of its survival mechanisms.

programme.title: Caribbean sisters: The Lesser Antilles St. Kitts & Nevis
programme.desc: In the centre of the Caribbean, volcanoes rise steeply from the sea, thus shaping the sister islands of St. Kitts & Nevis. Their slopes, covered in lush rainforests, snow-white, sandy beaches and the surrounding tur-quoise tinted waters provide the ultimate setting for this record-breaking, albeit tiny island paradise: Both islets are the smallest of the Caribbean dwarf states and also rank among the world's ten smallest states. A hot pepper sauce, made of a creative mixture of ginger, garlic, thyme and extraordinarily hot chillies that thrive in the hot and humid climate of Nevis, is simmering on the stove of Violet and Llewellyn's house. Lemmy Pemberton digs up abandoned turtle nests with his bare hands, as he wants to be certain that all of the babies have indeed managed to make it. Members of the Turtle Group catch sea turtles in order to take their measurements and fit them with transmitters. Taxi bus-es are not only the main means of transport on St. Kitts & Nevis, they are also an artistic expression of each driver's personality. Colourfully embellished, each taxi represents island art on wheels.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Olympic National Park is an American national park located in the State of Washington, on the Olympic Peninsula. The park has four regions: the Pacific coastline, alpine areas, the west side temperate rainforest and the forests of the drier east side. Within the park there are three distinct ecosystems which are subalpine forest and wildflower meadow, temperate forest, and the rugged Pacific coast. President Theodore Roosevelt originally designated Mount Olympus National Monument on 2 March 1909. The monument was redesignated as a national park by Congress and President Franklin Roosevelt on June 29, 1938. In 1976, Olympic National Park was designated by UNESCO as an International Biosphere Reserve, and in 1981 as a World Heritage Site. In 1988, Congress designated 95 percent of the park as the Olympic Wilderness.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yosemite National Park is a place of superlatives: with towering cliffs and giant sequoias, home to coyotes, black bears and the most elusive of all: the bobcat. Watch this documentary with ist spectacular shots, aerial views and time-lapse shots and learn some new facts about the biodiversity in one of North Americas most spectacular National Parks.

programme.title: Wild Prairie Man
programme.desc: Located in the Northern Great Plains of Canada, Grasslands National Park has been a 20 year odyssey for wildlife photographer James R. Page. For James, critters are more interesting than people and he shares some of his iconic images and experiences from this endangered ecosystem. We showcase the parks wilderness that is dominated by prairie light and dark sky, the wildlife, prairie dogs, mesmerizing landscapes, and bisons. We immerse ourselves in the wild habitat of Grasslands National Park for over a year capturing some never before scenes in the Wild Prairie. James R. Page's connection to the land and the wildlife provides an unforgettable journey into the heart of this endangered ecosystem, while Park experts help us understand its complexity.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: To the North
programme.desc: Benny Rebel approaches a big cat in the semi desert with caution. An Asiatic cheetah is like an icon of Iranian nature. The carnivore accepts Benny in its closer environment. The photographer takes breath taking shots. Rewarded in this way Rebel continues his challenging expedition in a high mood. Deep in the desert he manages to come close to the last Wild Ass, so called Onager. The horse like animals are very shy and rare. From his hideouts Benny observes chinkaras, antelopes and impressive horned wild sheep in the mountains. Passing the snow topped Mount Damavand he reaches the green north part of Iran. In the oldest national park Golestan not only massive Marals and wild boars roam. Here also Persian leopards and brown bears crossing their ways. Near the mystical forest of Persia the journey ends at the biggest inland lake of the world: the Caspian Sea. There Benny stalks on the pink flamingoes which gather there for feeding. The number and variety of species and landscapes of Iran is overwhelming but also endangered. On his photo and film expedition Benny Rebel documents the natural resources of Iran - also, to convince the government of his home country to protect their unique treasures of nature and culture.

programme.title: Between Finland and Sweden
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest ocean in the world and first evolved after the last Ice Age. We think we know everything about it, yet still it has many surprises in store. Wind and waves still shape the shores of the Baltic Sea to this day. The third episode takes us to the Bay of Bothnia. More than double the size of the Netherlands, it is the most unknown region of the Baltic Sea. In the winter, the Baltic Sea freezes over at a length of 300 kilometres. In this 1-metre-thick ice tank, the third species of seal - alongside the grey seal and common seal - copes well with the Baltic Sea. The ringed seal is perfectly adapted to the Arctic winter and carves out breathing holes into the ice. More than 10,000 of the animals still live between Sweden and Finland. The Bay of Bothnia only has a salt content of just 1%, which is why it freezes quicker than other regions of the Baltic Sea. Many rivers disembogue here and “sweeten” the sea. The Tornio is the longest natural river in Europe. It forms the border between Sweden and Finland. Even when frost is severe, the Kukkolaforsen rapids in Sweden never freeze over, otters go hunting here. When it gets dark in the winter, solar winds conjure colourful light effects in the Baltic Sea sky. The Aurora Borealis can be seen in the northern regions of the Baltic Sea as of mid-October. The coast of Lapland is also the home of the reindeer. The Sami's, reindeer breeders, bring their herds in winter to the Baltic Sea, as the snow is not as deep here as it is further inland and the animals have better access to lichens and mosses. When Lapland's coast is still frozen, 300 kilometres further south in the Kvarken Archipelago, a special spectacle takes place. Millions of fish head for the coast. Barrier beaches prevent them from reaching the coastal lagoons. They can only spawn where the water is salt-free.

They list the various traditions they love about the season but the one they all agree on is the Glimmerberry Ball. Strawberry mentions that she doesn't think the café can hold the party this year because of how the town has grown. The girls decide to split up and search for a new location.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Lemon is ecstatic. She races out of her salon and goes around to the other girls' houses proclaiming that she "did it!" and beckoning them to join her. They follow her back and are completely dazzled by her newest creation - Glamicures. They are brightly colored, jeweled manicures with tiny microchips inside that play songs when the wearer moves her hand. Each girl lines up to receive her new glamicure and soon there is a cacophony of color and sound.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While working in her store, Orange overhears the Berrykins laughing and shouting outside. When she goes to the door to investigate, a clump of dandelion fluff gets blown inside chased by three Berrykins. She watches as they head butt the clump around until it floats back toward Orange. Just as it floats close, she gives it a bat sending it outside and the Berrykins happily chasing after it. Wanting in on the fun, she joins them.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: While enjoying lunch in the café, the girls are interrupted by some music coming from the gazebo. They head outside and find Sadiebug and Kadiebug wearing badges and standing by a banner and podium. A group of chairs are set up in front of them. The twins begin to announce, and then argue, that they are starting a club - a good citizens club. The girls are shocked as the twins argue with each other all the time.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With all the Baby Berrykins running around Berry Bitty City, Princess Berrykin decides to build a Day Care Center and playground. But she's worried because it's dull-looking - all grey metal and brown wood. She asks Strawberry whom might be good to help her out. And two names immediately come to her mind - Lemon and Raspberry! The Princess confesses she's always admired their sense of design and style.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: After returning to the café after a walk with her pets, Strawberry is met by Mr. Longface. He's been waiting for her so that they can get started making treats and decorating for Sadiebug's and Kadiebug's party that afternoon. But Custard and Pupcake have enjoyed their time outside so much that they want to continue playing.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

programme.title: Country Girls
programme.desc: When the girls go to Mia's grandparents' ranch and Olivia accidentally knocks down the neighbor's barn, the girls promise to raise money to rebuild it and now have to learn to set aside their differences and work together to make good on their promise. Mia invites her friends to her grandparents' ranch for the weekend. But when Olivia accidentally knocks down a neighbor's barn with a tractor, the girls promise to raise the money to rebuild it themselves. Complicating matters, Mia and Stephanie turn out to like the same boy, Martin. They'll have to learn to set aside their differences and work together if they're going to raise enough money to make good on their promise.

programme.title: Emma's Dilemma
programme.desc: When Stephanie becomes obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in a float building contest and accidentally disregards Emma's ideas and design, Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to get revenge on Stephanie. When the girls enter a float-building contest, Emma is especially excited to share her design idea for the float. But no one is listening to her, especially Stephanie, who's become obsessed with beating her rival Tanya in the contest. Emma finally does find someone who appreciates her design… Tanya! Tanya convinces Emma to join her team to build the float design. But is Tanya just using Emma to get revenge on Stephanie?

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Chased Dreamers
programme.desc: To craft their own hourglasses and become official Dream Chasers for the Night Bureau, Mateo and his friends must defeat the Dream Forge guardian.

programme.title: The Dream Forge
programme.desc: As time runs out to face the Dream Forge and become official Dream Chasers, Mateo and his friends enlist the help of the mysterious Dream Bandit.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.19
programme.desc: On her way to warn Hwon of an impending rebellion, Bogyeong witnesses him sharing a tender moment with Yeonwoo. Driven by jealousy and fear, Bogyeong summons Kwon, the former head shaman of Seongsucheong, and orders her to place a dark curse upon Yeonwoo.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.20
programme.desc: As Hwon heads toward the Royal Ancestral Shrine, he is surrounded by Yoon Daehyeong's private soldiers. Leading the rebel forces, Yangmyung raises his sword against Hwon, while Yoon Daehyeong coldly orders that the king be executed. Meanwhile, Yeonwoo, fleeing to a hideout with Hong Gyu-tae, is seized by a deep and ominous premonition.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.1
programme.desc: While seeing off Jaein—the girlfriend of his senior colleague— Minwoo witnesses the aftermath of a massive ten-car pileup. Though Minwoo is a doctor, he hesitates to get involved. Meanwhile, Sejung Hospital is overwhelmed as injured patients begin pouring in, and Inhyuk insists on accepting them—even if it means pushing the hospital beyond its limits.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving day!

programme.title: Sharing a Rental Horror Story
programme.desc: I spent a bit over a month in LA while 'working from home', filming some videos, and visiting some people.

programme.title: Check Out This Cool Thrift Find for Our Office
programme.desc: You've all been waiting for it, the final touches for the office on this season of Loft Vibes are here!

programme.title: IKEA Furnitue Hacks (Bathroom Vanity)
programme.desc: Upgrade your IKEA HEMNES bed! Learn to create a custom, budget/renter-friendly MCM piece.

programme.title: The Backpacker Chef EP7
programme.desc: Experience a unique twist as soccer players swap their cleats for aprons, transforming into chefs.

programme.title: The Backpacker Chef EP8
